note: v1 predicate registry — repo-tracked JSON. Add-a-predicate = PR + deploy. See docs/scenario-builder-design.md §3.3.

predicates.label: Boost membership
predicates.description: Loans in the AFN Boost DPA program.

predicates.label: Arrive/Aurora membership
predicates.description: Loans in the Arrive/Aurora DPA program.

predicates.label: Elevate FHA membership
predicates.description: Loans in the Elevate FHA Loan Program (bucketed under dpa_program='Other'; match by dpa_name).

predicates.label: All AFN-proprietary DPA (Boost + Arrive/Aurora + Elevate)
predicates.description: S4-scope union: Boost OR Arrive/Aurora OR Elevate FHA. v16 assertion: pairwise overlap == 0 on 2026-06.

predicates.label: Gift fund ≥ 50% source-of-funds AND no reserves
predicates.description: Composite: gift_grant_group ∈ {'50%-74.99%', '75%+'} AND reserves_group == '0'. Default from v16 Enhanced Guidelines carve-out; registry-configurable via gift_grant_groups + reserves_group_zero params.

predicates.label: Fails Enhanced Guidelines (Boost only)
predicates.description: v16 Enhanced Guidelines carve-out. **Boost-only scope** per snapshot-side EG flag (docs/scenario-builder-design.md §9 Q3). Uses the snapshot's fails_enhanced_guidelines field, which is populated for Boost loans only.
predicates.scope_note: Fires on Boost membership only. Committee-wide EG evaluation across all proprietary DPA would require Encompass upstream changes.

predicates.label: Manual underwriting
predicates.description: Loans originated via manual underwriting (not AUS-approved). v16 S3/S4 removes these.

predicates.label: Front-end DTI over FICO-tiered cap (35% if FICO 660-699, 42% if FICO 700+)
predicates.description: v16 S3/S4 tiered front-end DTI cap: FICO 660-699 must have front-end DTI ≤ 35%; FICO ≥700 must have front-end DTI ≤ 42%. Fires when the loan's front-end DTI exceeds the applicable cap. Loans with FICO<660 (or FICO=None) are excluded here (they are caught by fico_lt_660 or by the compound boost_dti_tiered_v16 predicate).

predicates.label: v16 Boost Guidelines Tightening — FICO/front-DTI ladder (rule 1+2+3)
predicates.description: v16 R002 (S3/S4) rule set — the three FICO branches encoded as ONE compound predicate to match the workbook language: '(1) FICO<660 or None; (2) FICO 660-699 with front-end DTI >35.0%; (3) FICO 700+ with front-end DTI >42.0%'. Fires when ANY of the three branches is true for a loan. Branch (1) matches missing/null FICO because v16 R002 says 'or None' explicitly; branches (2)/(3) require finite FICO and finite front_dti. Front-end DTI stored as percentage (e.g. 35.0), compared with > (strict, per v16 language 'greater than 35.0%').
predicates.source_note: v16 workbook 'S3 Committee — Boost Guidelines' R002 (verbatim): 'Boost Guidelines Tightening + persistent EG carve-out. Remove Boost loans that fail ANY of: (1) FICO<660 or None; (2) FICO 660-699 with front-end DTI >35.0%; (3) FICO 700+ with front-end DTI >42.0%; (4) uses manual underwriting; (5) fails Enhanced Guidelines (persistent carve-out, no delinquency qualifier). Non-Boost loans unaffected.' This predicate encodes branches (1)+(2)+(3) as a single unit. Branches (4)/(5) remain separate leaves (manual_uw, fails_enhanced_guidelines).
